title: Austrian Windatlas
description: Observation-constrained hourly wind climatology for Austria — reference implementation and companion library to Schicker et al. (2026, Climate). Nine Stage-1 interpolation families (IDW, RK-IDW, KED, MLR, GAM/BAMLSS, QN-GNN-CNN, Amato, Enhanced-MAE, Enhanced-WMSE) under a common EOF/rPCA framework, seven Stage-2 hub-height extrapolation formulations (power / log / enhanced / stability / adaptive / hybrid / ensemble), plus the validation harness (RMSE / bias / r / threshold metrics / Weibull / capacity factor) used in the paper.
